CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2584 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head bf10abe62926bc8d93be779ae859a985e5365aa6. Bus nonce: 954bb4c2dddb4ba467f3570a4cc38f13. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin bf10abe62926bc8d93be779ae859a985e5365aa6`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge bf10abe62926bc8d93be779ae859a985e5365aa6` or `Fix review: blocked bf10abe62926bc8d93be779ae859a985e5365aa6 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 954bb4c2dddb4ba467f3570a4cc38f13`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `bf10abe62926bc8d93be779ae859a985e5365aa6` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2584 bf10abe62926bc8d93be779ae859a985e5365aa6") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2584-954bb4c2`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Re-review of PR #2584 (R10-FLOW-MAIN-GATE, branch fix/r10-flow-main-gate) at the new head bf10abe6 (the fixer's round 2 plus a main merge). Round 1 was blocked; read the last 'Fix review: blocked' comment on #2584 and verify each blocking item is repaired with the finder's harness, not the fixer's: mutation proof, null controls, every body figure re-measured at this head, ## Red checks answers each red check-run at this head truthfully (a tick report says nightly-status is red: it grades main; confirm the diff touches no input of it), git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main <head> clean, and the group spec (pack file dev/programme/flow-study/roster/groups/R10-FLOW-MAIN-GATE.json at pin 30c57744a, git fetch origin claude/dazzling-gauss-7l3u2b). Standing rule 19: every observation in your verdict ends with a marker in carry_audit grammar, `Carry: <GROUP>` (a group on origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster), `Carry: #<issue>`, or `Carry: dismissed: <reason of two or more words>`, each ending (item <id>); the colon after dismissed is required; run python3 tools/audit/carry_audit.py --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster check over your verdict text and require 0 unrouted. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md. First line `Fix review: merge <head>` or blocked.
